releaseNotes:
- Dialogue audio supports filtering, batch voice selection and generation, line-by-line tuning and explicit adoption while preserving recordings and recoverable work.
- Illustrations and videos have distinct browsing and creation workflows while existing assets and playback remain compatible.
- Upload local assets directly from the Gallery and ask the Agent to adapt them, with more reliable selection and related-asset refresh.
- Preview and the standalone player improve dialogue audio, choices, backgrounds and media rendering while avoiding unchanged refreshes.
- Publishing reuses adopted dialogue audio without synthesizing new speech; missing audio is clearly reported without blocking text-only publication.
- Shared Projects can open a maintenance copy of the effective live version, preserving existing assets, covers and project metadata more reliably.
- Temporary storage controls, improved video-task recovery and support for available Claude Opus 5.5 adaptive thinking are included.
releaseNotesZh:
- 台词配音支持筛选、批量选声与生成、逐句精修及明确采用，保留已有录音和待恢复任务。
- 插画与视频分开展示和创作，保留旧素材兼容与已有播放成果。
- 可在素材页直接上传本地素材，并让 Agent 帮助适配；选择与关联素材刷新更可靠。
- 预览与独立播放器改善对白音频、选项、背景和媒体显示，并减少无变化时的重复刷新。
- 发布复用已采用的配音，不自动合成；缺少配音会明确提示，但不阻止无配音发布。
- 共享项目可打开线上有效版本的维护副本，发布时更可靠地保留现有素材、封面和作品信息。
- 新增临时存储管理，改进视频任务恢复，并支持可用的 Claude Opus 5.5 自适应思考。
